about: Sun and Earth seen from the base, one value per day at 12:00 UTC. Label: computed. Earth elevation and lit fraction: JPL Horizons, checked 2026-11-14 (observer on the Moon at the site below). Sun azimuth: concept 3.0 §05 table, 12° a day, measured from the Earth-facing meridian (lunar longitude 0) = Horizons local azimuth + site longitude, agrees within 0.6°. Sun elevation is a game rule (1.5°): Horizons gives −0.7° to −0.1° for the Sun's centre at zero altitude that week, so the low Sun is true to the week but the number is not measured.
